raw_articles.text: RAW_HISTORY_TITLE This article has a new identifier and URL but exactly the same normalized title as a recent item. This fixture preserves the existing title-based historical guard without extending it to fuzzy matching or semantic event clustering.

raw_articles.title: 某公司完成新一轮融资
raw_articles.text: RAW_EXCLUDED_ZH 这是一条标题直接命中用户排除词的虚构融资新闻。这个摘要属于固定验收材料，不能作为真实新闻推送，也不应该在开启预筛选时进入模型的候选工作清单。审计归档仍然需要完整保留它。

raw_articles.title: New inference runtime
raw_articles.text: KEEP_AMBIGUOUS This technical release explains memory scheduling. A background paragraph mentions 融资 but that incidental body mention alone must not cause an early rejection. The editor still needs to determine the actual relevance and the final submission guard remains active.

raw_articles.title: Hardware scheduling notes
raw_articles.text: KEEP_NO_KEYWORD Processor queue scheduling is described without any literal subscription keyword. This candidate must remain available for the model to judge. Positive keyword matching is not a deterministic admission requirement in this project.

raw_articles.title: Runtime version one
raw_articles.text: KEEP_QUERY_ONE A meaningful version query identifies the first independent runtime report. Tracking-only parameters can be removed, but this version parameter must remain part of canonical URL identity so another version is not discarded.

raw_articles.title: Runtime version two
raw_articles.text: KEEP_QUERY_TWO A meaningful version query identifies the second independent runtime report. The two versioned links intentionally have different candidate identifiers and must both remain in the initial candidate set for model evaluation.

raw_articles.title: Reliable planning with external tools
raw_articles.text: KEEP_ARXIV This paper was first submitted earlier but was announced in today's RSS feed. Admission freshness must use the feed announcement instead of first submission time. The brief should label both dates correctly and must not claim the paper was first published today.
